title: Internal m_portCount incorrect in portsorch
author: mint570
body:
The m_portCount is incorrect in portsorch.

The count is first initialized by reading SAI during init: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/13ef25bf14d0b75d7ef5adec43493f206f701ff4/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L635

When PortConfigDone happens, the count will be reset to the new value: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/13ef25bf14d0b75d7ef5adec43493f206f701ff4/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3301

At this point, m_portCount should be the correct port count configured in the DB. This value can be different from the default value returned from SAI during init. However, the code will soon perform add ports and delete ports, which will increment and decrement m_portCount correspondingly: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/13ef25bf14d0b75d7ef5adec43493f206f701ff4/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3372-L3443

The final m_portCount will be different from what the DB configured. Given an example:
1. During init, SAI returns 64 ports: m_portCount = 64.
2. In the DB, it configured 56 ports. When PortConfigDone happens, m_portCount = 56.
3. Delete the invalid 64 ports: m_portCount = 56 - 64 = -8
4. Add the new 56 ports: m_portCount = -8 + 56 = 48

Currently, this m_portCount variable is only used in removeDefaultVlanMembers() and removeDefaultBridgePorts() for allocating buffers.

comments.author: mint570
comments.body:
This is the original PR that introduces the bug: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/320

But the original PR won't stop processing the counter from the DB even after config done. So the port count will be set to the correct one in the next config change. Later, this PR added the check to skip the port config done re-processing: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/653. This makes the port count to stay incorrect.
